reason: Carving the planks seems like a direct start toward the printing block.
expectation: I expect a carved printing block, though it may need another step.

alternatives.reason: Charcoal and water might make ink, but I want to start with the block.

effect: The carved planks made the printing block, so I can continue building the press.
reaction: Satisfying to get the expected block directly.
reason: Combining the block with iron looks like the next step toward the press.
expectation: I expect a press component or a printing press, though the iron's role is unclear.

alternatives.reason: Charcoal and water may make ink, but building the press is the current goal.

effect: The block and iron made the press, and the new goal is to print a page. The description explains how the screw presses paper against an inked block.
reaction: The explanation of the screw and plate made the result clearer.
reason: Charcoal and water may make the ink needed for printing.
expectation: I expect ink or an ink ingredient.

alternatives.reason: The paper will need to go at the press, but I expect ink will be needed too.

effect: Charcoal and water made ink, which can now be placed at the press.
reason: The carved block needs ink before it can print a page.
expectation: I expect the ink to be placed at the printing press, ready for printing.

alternatives.reason: The paper also needs to be placed at the press; I chose ink first.

effect: The ink is at the press, and paper can now be combined with it there.
reason: Combining the paper and ink at the press directly pursues the goal of printing a page.

effect: The press produced printed pages and completed the chapter; the description clarified that the same illustration is reproduced on each sheet.
reaction: Seeing the finished copies was satisfying, though the result was expected.

mostWorthwhile.text: Building the printing press was most worthwhile because its description explained how the screw and plate apply pressure to the inked block.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing the ink was a straightforward preparation with little to decide beyond ordering it before the paper.

surprise.text: The explanation of the iron screw and plate clarified how the press worked.

arbitrary.text: The iron's role was unclear when I selected the combination, but the resulting description explained it.

continue.text: I would be mildly interested in continuing to see another mechanism explained, though the offered compatible combinations made this chapter fairly predictable.
